claim: Can you put "smartPost" packages (with a USPS tracking number) in FedEx ...
summary: Best option is to take to a FedEx Office retail store or a Walgreens. If it’s a return I recommend Office since they can give you a receipt showing you handed it over to FedEx. If you place in a drop box and something happens to it where it doesn’t get scanned you will have no recourse to file a claim or prove you sent it. Reply reply ...
